The Slow Kitchen

Notes on bread, patience and the things that take longer than the recipe says they will.

This is where I write down what I have learned about baking at home, one loaf at a time. Everything here is written slowly and revised often, so nothing is ever quite finished, and most of it is wrong in some way I have not noticed yet. If you came here looking for a recipe you can follow in an afternoon, the archive below is not going to help you very much, and I would rather say so at the top than have you find it out four paragraphs down.

Written by hand, published from a laptop on a kitchen table. There is no newsletter, no tracking and no comment section, which suits everyone involved rather well.
